subject: Chair Election and Road Safety Advocacy
overview: The commission elected Chris Stivers as the new chair following the resignation of the previous chair. Members also established a working group to engage with local police on road safety and enforcement following a recent cyclist fatality.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes for the June 2026 meeting.

items.title: Chair Resignation Announcement
items.summary: Outgoing chair Daniel Nuzzo-Mueller announced his resignation effective in August due to moving out of the city.

items.title: A Simple Machine Film Presentation
items.summary: Filmmaker Mark presented his indie film about cycling economics and requested the commission's help in connecting with local cycling groups for future screenings.

items.title: Election of New Chair
items.summary: Elected Chris Stivers to the position of chair.

items.title: Vice Chair and Secretary Positions
items.summary: Tabled the election of a vice chair and secretary until the next meeting.

items.title: Farmers Market Tabling
items.summary: Coordinated volunteer coverage and logistics for the Farmers Market Bike Fest scheduled for July 30th.

items.title: Upcoming Fall Events
items.summary: Approved participation in Tufts Community Day on October 4th and the Harvest Your Energy festival on October 17th.

items.title: South Medford Connector Path
items.summary: Voted to sign onto a Historical Commission letter supporting a riverfront path for the South Medford Connector while acknowledging a temporary ramp as an interim measure.

items.title: Road Safety Advocacy and Police Engagement
items.summary: Formed a working group to meet with the Medford Police Department to discuss cycling safety enforcement, data tracking, and incident reporting following a recent fatality.

items.title: Legislative Advocacy Petitions
items.summary: Authorized the chair to sign road safety petitions and legislative advocacy letters on behalf of the commission between regular meetings.

items.title: Routine Maintenance and Bike Rack Reports
items.summary: Reviewed a complaint regarding a West Medford bike rack and confirmed that the Medford Square bike lane is currently marked with appropriate no-parking signs.
